connectors.exemple: The city is beautiful. Moreover, it is very cheap to live there.

connectors.traduccio: La ciutat és preciosa. A més, és molt barat viure-hi.

connectors.exemple: Social media can be addictive. Furthermore, it can affect our self-esteem.
connectors.exempleMarcat: Social media can be addictive. **Furthermore**, it can affect our self-esteem.
connectors.forat: Social media can be addictive. ___, it can affect our self-esteem.
connectors.traduccio: Les xarxes socials poden ser addictives. A més, poden afectar la nostra autoestima.

connectors.exemple: Students have to study for the PAU. In addition, many of them have part-time jobs.
connectors.exempleMarcat: Students have to study for the PAU. **In addition**, many of them have part-time jobs.
connectors.forat: Students have to study for the PAU. ___, many of them have part-time jobs.
connectors.traduccio: Els alumnes han d'estudiar per a la PAU. A més, molts tenen feines a temps parcial.
connectors.nota: No el confonguis amb *in addition to*, que va seguit d'un nom o d'un -ing.

connectors.exemple: The flat is very small. What is more, it doesn't have any heating.
connectors.exempleMarcat: The flat is very small. **What is more**, it doesn't have any heating.
connectors.forat: The flat is very small. ___, it doesn't have any heating.
connectors.traduccio: El pis és molt petit. I a més, no té calefacció.

connectors.exemple: I don't want to go out tonight. Besides, I have an exam tomorrow.
connectors.exempleMarcat: I don't want to go out tonight. **Besides**, I have an exam tomorrow.

connectors.traduccio: No vull sortir aquesta nit. A més, demà tinc un examen.
connectors.nota: També pot anar davant d'un nom o d'un -ing: *Besides studying, she works.*

connectors.exemple: In addition to studying, she works at weekends.
connectors.exempleMarcat: **In addition to** studying, she works at weekends.
connectors.forat: ___ studying, she works at weekends.
connectors.traduccio: A més d'estudiar, treballa els caps de setmana.
connectors.nota: Va seguit d'un nom o d'un verb en -ing, mai d'una frase.

connectors.exemple: The course includes grammar as well as vocabulary.
connectors.exempleMarcat: The course includes grammar **as well as** vocabulary.

connectors.traduccio: El curs inclou gramàtica, així com vocabulari.

connectors.exemple: She plays the piano and she also sings in a choir.
connectors.exempleMarcat: She plays the piano and she **also** sings in a choir.
connectors.forat: She plays the piano and she ___ sings in a choir.
connectors.traduccio: Toca el piano i també canta en un cor.
connectors.nota: Va davant del verb principal, però darrere de *to be*: *She is also tired.*

connectors.exemple: I love horror films, and my sister loves them too.
connectors.exempleMarcat: I love horror films, and my sister loves them **too**.
connectors.forat: I love horror films, and my sister loves them ___.
connectors.traduccio: M'encanten les pel·lícules de terror, i a la meva germana també.

connectors.exemple: I'm going to the party, and Marc is coming as well.
connectors.exempleMarcat: I'm going to the party, and Marc is coming **as well**.

connectors.traduccio: Vaig a la festa, i en Marc també hi ve.

connectors.exemple: The exam was difficult. However, most students passed.

connectors.traduccio: L'examen era difícil. Tanmateix, la majoria d'alumnes van aprovar.
connectors.nota: És el *but* formal. A l'inici de la frase i amb coma. A la redacció de la PAU queda molt millor que *but*.

connectors.exemple: The weather was terrible. Nevertheless, we enjoyed the trip.
connectors.exempleMarcat: The weather was terrible. **Nevertheless**, we enjoyed the trip.
connectors.forat: The weather was terrible. ___, we enjoyed the trip.
connectors.traduccio: Feia un temps horrible. No obstant això, vam gaudir del viatge.

connectors.exempleMarcat: It was a risky plan. **Nonetheless**, they decided to go ahead.

connectors.traduccio: Era un pla arriscat. Tot i així, van decidir tirar endavant.

connectors.exemple: I wanted to go to the concert, but the tickets were too expensive.

connectors.exemple: The task seemed easy, yet nobody could solve it.
connectors.exempleMarcat: The task seemed easy, **yet** nobody could solve it.

connectors.exemple: Although it was raining, we went to the beach.
connectors.exempleMarcat: **Although** it was raining, we went to the beach.
connectors.forat: ___ it was raining, we went to the beach.
connectors.traduccio: Tot i que plovia, vam anar a la platja.

connectors.exemple: Even though he studied hard, he failed the exam.
connectors.exempleMarcat: **Even though** he studied hard, he failed the exam.

connectors.exemple: Though she was tired, she kept on working.

connectors.forat: ___ she was tired, she kept on working.
connectors.traduccio: Encara que estava cansada, va continuar treballant.

connectors.exemple: Despite the rain, the match went ahead.
connectors.exempleMarcat: **Despite** the rain, the match went ahead.
connectors.forat: ___ the rain, the match went ahead.
connectors.traduccio: Malgrat la pluja, el partit es va jugar.

connectors.exemple: In spite of being very tired, she finished her essay.

connectors.forat: ___ being very tired, she finished her essay.
connectors.traduccio: Malgrat que estava molt cansada, va acabar la redacció.
connectors.nota: Com *despite*, però amb *of*. Va seguit d'un nom o d'un -ing.

connectors.exemple: My brother loves maths, whereas I prefer languages.
connectors.exempleMarcat: My brother loves maths, **whereas** I prefer languages.

connectors.traduccio: Al meu germà li encanten les mates, mentre que jo prefereixo les llengües.

connectors.exemple: Some people love social media, while others hate it.
connectors.exempleMarcat: Some people love social media, **while** others hate it.
connectors.forat: Some people love social media, ___ others hate it.
connectors.traduccio: A alguns els encanten les xarxes socials, mentre que d'altres les odien.
connectors.nota: *While* també vol dir "mentre" (temps). Aquí compara dues idees.

connectors.exemple: Living in a city is exciting. On the other hand, it can be very stressful.
connectors.exempleMarcat: Living in a city is exciting. **On the other hand**, it can be very stressful.
connectors.forat: Living in a city is exciting. ___, it can be very stressful.
connectors.traduccio: Viure en una ciutat és emocionant. En canvi, pot ser molt estressant.

connectors.exemple: We didn't take the bus. We walked instead.
connectors.exempleMarcat: We didn't take the bus. We walked **instead**.
connectors.forat: We didn't take the bus. We walked ___.
connectors.traduccio: No vam agafar el bus. En lloc d'això, vam anar a peu.

connectors.exemple: Instead of going out, I stayed at home to study.
connectors.exempleMarcat: **Instead of** going out, I stayed at home to study.
connectors.forat: ___ going out, I stayed at home to study.
connectors.traduccio: En lloc de sortir, em vaig quedar a casa a estudiar.
connectors.nota: Va seguit d'un nom o d'un -ing.

connectors.exemple: The film wasn't boring. On the contrary, it was fascinating.
connectors.exempleMarcat: The film wasn't boring. **On the contrary**, it was fascinating.
connectors.forat: The film wasn't boring. ___, it was fascinating.
connectors.traduccio: La pel·lícula no era avorrida. Al contrari, era fascinant.
connectors.nota: Serveix per negar el que s'ha dit abans. No és el mateix que *on the other hand*.

connectors.exemple: In the north, it's cold and rainy. In contrast, the south is hot and dry.
connectors.exempleMarcat: In the north, it's cold and rainy. **In contrast**, the south is hot and dry.
connectors.forat: In the north, it's cold and rainy. ___, the south is hot and dry.
connectors.traduccio: Al nord fa fred i plou. En canvi, el sud és càlid i sec.

connectors.exemple: I stayed at home because I had a terrible cold.
connectors.exempleMarcat: I stayed at home **because** I had a terrible cold.
connectors.forat: I stayed at home ___ I had a terrible cold.
connectors.traduccio: Em vaig quedar a casa perquè tenia un refredat terrible.

connectors.exemple: The flight was cancelled because of the storm.
connectors.exempleMarcat: The flight was cancelled **because of** the storm.
connectors.forat: The flight was cancelled ___ the storm.
connectors.traduccio: El vol es va cancel·lar a causa de la tempesta.
connectors.nota: Va seguit d'un nom, no d'una frase.

connectors.exemple: Since it was late, we decided to take a taxi.
connectors.exempleMarcat: **Since** it was late, we decided to take a taxi.
connectors.forat: ___ it was late, we decided to take a taxi.
connectors.traduccio: Com que era tard, vam decidir agafar un taxi.
connectors.nota: *Since* també vol dir "des de" (temps).

connectors.exemple: As I didn't have any money, I couldn't buy the book.
connectors.exempleMarcat: **As** I didn't have any money, I couldn't buy the book.
connectors.forat: ___ I didn't have any money, I couldn't buy the book.
connectors.traduccio: Com que no tenia diners, no vaig poder comprar el llibre.

connectors.exemple: The match was postponed due to bad weather.
connectors.exempleMarcat: The match was postponed **due to** bad weather.
connectors.forat: The match was postponed ___ bad weather.
connectors.traduccio: El partit es va ajornar a causa del mal temps.
connectors.nota: Va seguit d'un nom. Per a una frase: *due to the fact that...*

connectors.significat: a causa de, per culpa de
connectors.exemple: Owing to a technical problem, the train was delayed.
connectors.exempleMarcat: **Owing to** a technical problem, the train was delayed.
connectors.forat: ___ a technical problem, the train was delayed.
connectors.traduccio: A causa d'un problema tècnic, el tren va anar amb retard.

connectors.exemple: Thanks to her help, I passed the exam.
connectors.exempleMarcat: **Thanks to** her help, I passed the exam.
connectors.forat: ___ her help, I passed the exam.
connectors.traduccio: Gràcies a la seva ajuda, vaig aprovar l'examen.
connectors.nota: Per a causes positives.

connectors.exemple: He didn't study at all. Therefore, he failed the exam.
connectors.exempleMarcat: He didn't study at all. **Therefore**, he failed the exam.
connectors.forat: He didn't study at all. ___, he failed the exam.
connectors.traduccio: No va estudiar gens. Per tant, va suspendre l'examen.
connectors.nota: El *so* formal. Perfecte per a la redacció.

connectors.exemple: The company lost a lot of money. Consequently, 200 workers were laid off.
connectors.exempleMarcat: The company lost a lot of money. **Consequently**, 200 workers were laid off.
connectors.forat: The company lost a lot of money. ___, 200 workers were laid off.
connectors.traduccio: L'empresa va perdre molts diners. En conseqüència, van acomiadar 200 treballadors.

connectors.exemple: Many people work from home now. As a result, there is less traffic.
connectors.exempleMarcat: Many people work from home now. **As a result**, there is less traffic.
connectors.forat: Many people work from home now. ___, there is less traffic.
connectors.traduccio: Ara molta gent treballa des de casa. Per això, hi ha menys trànsit.
connectors.nota: No el confonguis amb *as a result of* + nom (causa).

connectors.exemple: It was raining, so we stayed at home.
connectors.exempleMarcat: It was raining, **so** we stayed at home.
connectors.forat: It was raining, ___ we stayed at home.
connectors.traduccio: Plovia, així que ens vam quedar a casa.
connectors.nota: Informal. A la redacció, millor *therefore* o *as a result*.

connectors.exemple: Prices went up. Thus, many families had to spend less.
connectors.exempleMarcat: Prices went up. **Thus**, many families had to spend less.
connectors.forat: Prices went up. ___, many families had to spend less.
connectors.traduccio: Els preus van pujar. Així doncs, moltes famílies van haver de gastar menys.
connectors.nota: Molt formal.

connectors.exemple: She saved money in order to travel around Europe.
connectors.exempleMarcat: She saved money **in order to** travel around Europe.
connectors.forat: She saved money ___ travel around Europe.
connectors.traduccio: Va estalviar diners per viatjar per Europa.
connectors.nota: Va seguit de l'infinitiu sense *to* extra: *in order to travel*. Negatiu: *in order not to*.

connectors.exemple: We left early so as to avoid the traffic.
connectors.exempleMarcat: We left early **so as to** avoid the traffic.
connectors.forat: We left early ___ avoid the traffic.

connectors.exemple: I'll write it down so that I don't forget it.
connectors.exempleMarcat: I'll write it down **so that** I don't forget it.
connectors.forat: I'll write it down ___ I don't forget it.
connectors.traduccio: Ho apuntaré perquè no se m'oblidi.
connectors.nota: ⚠️ Va seguit d'una frase (sovint amb *can*, *could*, *will*, *would*). Amb un infinitiu, *in order to*.

connectors.exemple: You won't pass unless you study harder.
connectors.exempleMarcat: You won't pass **unless** you study harder.
connectors.forat: You won't pass ___ you study harder.

connectors.exemple: You can borrow my laptop as long as you're careful with it.
connectors.exempleMarcat: You can borrow my laptop **as long as** you're careful with it.
connectors.forat: You can borrow my laptop ___ you're careful with it.
connectors.traduccio: Pots agafar el meu portàtil sempre que hi vagis amb compte.

connectors.exemple: You can go to the party provided that you're home by midnight.

connectors.exemple: Take an umbrella in case it rains.

connectors.traduccio: Agafa un paraigua per si de cas plou.

connectors.exemple: Hurry up. Otherwise, we'll miss the bus.
connectors.exempleMarcat: Hurry up. **Otherwise**, we'll miss the bus.
